name: counter
summary: CSS counter for a list, with optional text before and after the number.
caveats: Numbering restarts on every item, each showing the first number, when the items are size containers (`container-type: inline-size`): containment scopes counters to each item.

arguments.name: $params
accepts: a prefix, a counter style and a suffix
var(), attr(), counter() or counters() in place of a prefix or suffix, written as they are
